correctness.rationale: Units have diagonal entries (a,c_1,...,c_b,d) in (F_q^*)^{b+2}, offdiagonal X,Y in F_q^b and central Z. Incidence-convolution commutation is exactly (a-c_i)X_i′-(alpha-gamma_i)X_i=0, (c_i-d)Y_i′-(gamma_i-delta)Y_i=0, and (a-d)Z′-(alpha-delta)Z+sum_i(X_iY_i′-X_i′Y_i)=0. Split diagonal pairs u=(a,alpha), v=(d,delta). If u!=v, two-vector constraints count q²(q²-1) per middle pair, and Z,Z′ have q choices; if u=v and exactly k intermediate pairs coincide, a nondegenerate 2k-dimensional alternating pairing has q^{4k-1}+(q-1)q^{2k-1} zero-pair solutions (interpreted as 1 at k=0). Binomial sum divided by |G|=(q-1)^{b+2}q^{2b+1} gives q(q-2)(q+1)^b+(2q)^b+(q-1)^{b+1}. All formulas use general finite-field linear algebra and hold in characteristic 2. Fresh independent brute force of commuting ordered pairs for (q,b)=(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1) gave 5,17,65,22 classes, respectively. Finite enumeration supports but does not replace this symbolic all-q,b derivation.
residual_risks: Independent direct checks only use prime fields q=2,3, not arbitrary prime-power arithmetic.
